protocol: ONE fixed contrast-calibrated hematoxylin proxy versus shared-affine gray

image_preprocessing.name: hematoxylin_proxy

fixed.fractions_scope: each input's own original gray support; reporting only

moving.fractions_scope: each input's own original gray support; reporting only

image_preprocessing.calibration: each input linear H q99 on own original gray support, floor1e-6, frozen at512 before pyramid/affine
image_preprocessing.diagnostics_scope: unwarped normalized channels; moving support is reporting only
image_preprocessing.moving_descriptor_prewarp_scope: once per raster scale; construction/support metadata in mind_frame_by_resolution
